boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Bellarmine University
boards.description: When the library closes or the game ends, Bellarmine students head to these reliable late-night spots in the Highlands and along Bardstown Road for fuel and community.

cards.title: Palio
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late Knight Dining
cards.notes: Order via touch-screen kiosks for fresh meals. This high-tech venue accepts Late Knight meal swipes for students staying on campus after hours.
cards.short_summary: A technology-focused on-campus dining venue offering digital ordering and late-night meal options for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Palio features Food on Demand (FoD) and accepts Late Knight Meal Swipes, Flex Dollars, cash, and credit cards.
cards.access_notes: Located in the University Center; check seasonal schedules for specific Late Knight service hours.

cards.title: Spinelli's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: Highlands Pizza Staple
cards.notes: Grab a massive slice of Philly-style pizza at this eclectic Highlands spot. It is a go-to for students due to its proximity and 5 AM closing time.
cards.short_summary: A late-night pizzeria in the Highlands known for its Philadelphia-style slices and late operating hours until 5 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Highlands location at 614 Baxter Ave is open for dine-in and delivery from 11 AM to 5 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 5:00 AM daily for late-night dining and carry-out.

cards.title: La Bamba
cards.subtitle: Burritos as Big as Your Head
cards.notes: Famous for oversized burritos, this Bardstown Road favorite serves the student crowd well into the early morning hours.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant on Bardstown Road popular for its large burritos and late-night availability.
cards.evidence_claim: The Louisville location at 1237 Bardstown Rd is open until 3:00 AM for pickup.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM daily for pickup orders.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Sweet Treats
cards.notes: Perfect for late-night study sessions, this bakery delivers warm cookies to campus until 3 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A bakery specializing in warm cookie delivery and walk-in service late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Highlands location is open until 1 AM Sunday-Wednesday and 3 AM Thursday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Find an Insomnia Cookies Location Near You
cards.access_notes: Retail store open until 3:00 AM on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Jeff's Donuts
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Donut Destination
cards.notes: Located just a short drive from campus, this shop offers over 40 varieties of donuts at any hour of the day or night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour donut shop providing a wide selection of fresh pastries and coffee at all times.
cards.evidence_claim: The St. Matthews location at 6401 New Dutchmans Pkwy is open daily 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: Raising Cane's
cards.subtitle: Post-Game Chicken Fingers
cards.notes: A popular stop for chicken finger meals after Bellarmine athletic events, with the drive-thru serving late into the night.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food restaurant specializing in chicken fingers, located on the Bardstown Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The location at 1250 Bardstown Road is open until 1:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM for late-night cravings.

cards.title: QDOBA Mexican Eats
cards.subtitle: Midnight Burrito Bowls
cards.notes: Conveniently located at the intersection of Bardstown and Eastern Parkway, this spot is a reliable late-night option for customizable bowls.
cards.short_summary: A fast-casual Mexican restaurant offering burritos and tacos with late-night hours on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The 1500 Bardstown Rd location is open until 12:00 AM on Wednesday and Thursday nights.
cards.source_title: QDOBA in Louisville, KY on 1500 Bardstown Rd
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM on select nights; check current hours for weekend extensions.

cards.title: Waffle House
cards.subtitle: The 24-Hour Classic
cards.notes: The ultimate 24-hour fallback for breakfast food. It's a reliable destination for students when everything else is closed.
cards.short_summary: An iconic 24-hour diner serving American breakfast and comfort food at all times.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House #1444 at 7715 Bardstown Rd is open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Drive-Thru
cards.notes: A staple for quick, inexpensive late-night food. The drive-thru on Bardstown Road is a frequent stop for students heading back to campus.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food chain known for its late-night drive-thru service and Mexican-inspired menu.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 1069 Bardstown Rd serves the Highlands area with late-night hours.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Louisville, KY - 1069 Bardstown Rd
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru typically remains open later than the dining room; check local signage for exact closing times.

cards.title: Burger Girl Diner
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Neighborhood Diner
cards.notes: A local favorite for late-night burgers and breakfast. This 24/7 diner provides a classic atmosphere for late-night conversations.
cards.short_summary: A traditional 24-hour diner in Louisville offering a full menu of comfort food at any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: Burger Girl Diner is noted as being open 24/7 for those with midnight munchies.
cards.source_title: Where to find late-night food in Louisville
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student spaces and quiet corners across Bellarmine University's Highlands campus that define the daily Knight experience.

cards.title: The All-Night Study Hub
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, Level 1
cards.notes: Access this reliable space any time of day for late-night projects. It features computers, vending machines, and a coffee maker to fuel long sessions.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated 24/7 study space in the library equipped with technology and refreshments.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has a 24-hour study room available to students daily featuring computers, desks, a coffee maker, and vending machine.
cards.source_title: Seven ways the Bellarmine Library supports student success
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for students with valid ID.

cards.title: The Campus Living Room
cards.subtitle: Centro, Horrigan Hall 1st Floor
cards.notes: Relax by the fireplace or play a game of billiards in this cozy lounge. It is a primary social spot for both commuters and residents.
cards.short_summary: A central campus lounge in Centro featuring a fireplace, billiards, and comfortable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Knights Knook is a lounge area located on the 1st floor of Centro with lounge furniture, a fireplace, and a billiards table.
cards.access_notes: Located in the main campus center; accessible during building hours.

cards.title: Tuscan-Style Green Space
cards.subtitle: Siena Residence Complex
cards.notes: Gather at the fire pit or sit by the water feature in this landscaped courtyard. It serves as a scenic outdoor amphitheater for student events.
cards.short_summary: A central green space in the Siena complex featuring a fire pit and water feature.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboreto is a Tuscan-style green space at the center of the Siena complex with an amphitheater, fire pit, and water feature.
cards.source_title: Siena Terzo and Quarto - Residence Halls
cards.access_notes: Outdoor courtyard accessible to the campus community.

cards.title: World-Class Archive Gallery
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: View original manuscripts and drawings by the famous monk. The reading room offers a quiet, scholarly atmosphere for browsing his works.
cards.short_summary: The official repository of Thomas Merton's works, featuring a gallery and reading room.
cards.evidence_claim: The Thomas Merton Center is located on the second floor of the library and is open to casual visitors Monday-Friday, 9 am - 4 pm.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM.

cards.title: The Student Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Centro, Horrigan Hall 1st Floor
cards.notes: Heat up your lunch or store snacks in the shared refrigerator. This functional space is essential for students spending long days on campus.
cards.short_summary: A student kitchenette in Centro equipped with a refrigerator, microwave, and air fryer.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pit Stop is a kitchen area on the 1st floor of Centro with a refrigerator, sink, air fryer, and microwave.
cards.access_notes: Located across from Cafe Ogle; available during building hours.

cards.title: Recreational Free Play
cards.subtitle: Sport, Recreation and Fitness Center
cards.notes: Drop in for a pickup game of basketball or tennis. The center is a primary hub for non-varsity physical activity and intramural sports.
cards.short_summary: Indoor courts for basketball and tennis available for student recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The SuRF Center offers two basketball courts and three tennis courts for student use and intramural sports.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Monday-Thursday during fall/spring semesters.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady of the Woods Chapel
cards.title: Woodland Sanctuary
cards.subtitle: Bellarmine Boulevard
cards.notes: Visit this glass and steel masterpiece for a moment of quiet reflection. It is tucked away in a wooded area, offering a peaceful escape from campus noise.
cards.short_summary: A modern glass and wood chapel located in a quiet wooded area of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Our Lady of the Woods Chapel is a place of worship and art nestled on a hill in the woods, serving students of all faith traditions.
cards.source_title: About Our Lady of the Woods Chapel
cards.access_notes: Open for daily prayer and scheduled services.

cards.title: The Deep Focus Zone
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Utilize the whiteboards and large desks for intense individual study. This floor is strictly designated for silence to ensure maximum concentration.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent study area on the library's second floor with whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: On Level 2, a large 'silent study space' welcomes students to fill whiteboards with notes or focus on textbooks.
cards.source_title: Seven ways the Bellarmine Library supports student success
cards.access_notes: Subject to standard library hours.

cards.title: The End Zone Energy
cards.subtitle: Knights Hall
cards.notes: Join the crowd in the designated student end zone for basketball and volleyball games. It offers an intimate, high-energy atmosphere close to the court.
cards.short_summary: The dedicated student seating area in the historic on-campus arena.
cards.evidence_claim: Knights Hall provides an intimate feel with a student section in one end zone for basketball and volleyball programs.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during athletic events; student ID often required for section access.

cards.title: Inclusive Social Space
cards.subtitle: Centro, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Stop by this casual office and lounge to socialize or attend community events. It is a welcoming hub for students from diverse backgrounds.
cards.short_summary: A social and event space in Centro focused on diversity and inclusion.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carver Center office on the first floor of Centro is a great casual space to socialize and hosts events for students from diverse backgrounds.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard university business hours.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore Bellarmine University's best cost-free social spaces and activities, from world-class archives to scenic nature trails connecting the campus to the Highlands.

cards.title: Thomas Merton Center
cards.subtitle: World-renowned archival collection in the library
cards.notes: Visit the second floor of the library to see the world's largest collection of Thomas Merton's manuscripts and personal effects for free.
cards.short_summary: A major archival center housing the works and personal items of the famous monk and writer Thomas Merton.
cards.evidence_claim: The Merton Center is currently open to casual visitors from Monday-Friday, 9 am - 4 pm, and visitors are welcome to browse and read books in the reading room.
cards.source_title: The Thomas Merton Center at Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. for casual visitors; located on the second floor of the W.L. Lyons Brown Library.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady of the Woods Chapel
cards.title: Our Lady of the Woods Chapel
cards.subtitle: Peaceful glass and wood sanctuary
cards.notes: Stop by this architectural landmark for quiet meditation or attend a community Mass in a serene wooded setting.
cards.short_summary: A glass, wood, and steel chapel nestled in the campus woods, serving as a space for worship and interfaith meditation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chapel serves as a place for individual or small group prayer and meditation, and is open for prayer during the regular academic year.
cards.source_title: Our Lady of the Woods Chapel Use Policy - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Open for prayer and meditation during the academic year; Mass is celebrated on Sundays and holy days.

cards.title: McGrath Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Contemporary art in the Wyatt Center
cards.notes: View rotating exhibitions by regional and national artists in this 1,200-square-foot gallery space.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery featuring diverse exhibitions from professional and student artists throughout the year.
cards.evidence_claim: The McGrath Gallery offers 1,200 square feet of exhibit space for shows by regional, national, and student artists.
cards.source_title: Bachelor of Arts in Art - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Located in the Wyatt Center for the Arts; typically open during building hours for public viewing.

cards.title: SuRF Center Workouts
cards.subtitle: Free gym access for students
cards.notes: Current students can use the weight room, basketball courts, and tennis facilities at no extra cost with a valid ID.
cards.short_summary: The Sport, Recreation, and Fitness (SuRF) Center provides comprehensive gym and court facilities for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Membership to the Sport, Recreation, and Fitness Center (SuRF) is free for all current BU students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Free for current students with BU ID; requires annual completion of a membership packet.

cards.title: Beargrass Creek Walk
cards.subtitle: Scenic bridge and trail connection
cards.notes: Walk or bike across the bridge behind Nolen C. Allen Hall to connect directly with the Highlands and Poplar Level Road.
cards.short_summary: A paved multi-use path and bridge connecting the Bellarmine campus to surrounding Louisville neighborhoods.
cards.evidence_claim: The pathway begins behind Bellarmine's Nolen C. Allen Hall, with a bridge offering access to Nightingale Road; pedestrians are welcome during daylight hours.
cards.source_title: New walking path and bridge on campus create access over Beargrass Creek
cards.access_notes: Open to pedestrians and bicyclists during daylight hours.

cards.title: Joe Creason Park
cards.subtitle: Adjacent 41-acre public park
cards.notes: Access 1.5 miles of walking routes and scenic fitness loops directly from the campus multi-use path system.
cards.short_summary: A large public park bordering the university that offers extensive trails, open fields, and a bird sanctuary.
cards.evidence_claim: The path connects Joe Creason Park property with Bellarmine University property to create four possible walking routes.
cards.source_title: Bellarmine University connected with Joe Creason Park
cards.access_notes: Public park access is free; connected to campus via a dedicated pedestrian entrance at Newburg Road.

cards.title: Library Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Collaborative and silent zones
cards.notes: Reserve one of the many study rooms for up to three hours or use the 24-hour study room for late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering diverse study environments, including a 24-hour room and collaborative spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has a 24-hour study room available to students daily and eight study rooms on Levels 1 and A for collaboration.
cards.source_title: Seven ways the Bellarmine Library supports student success
cards.access_notes: 24-hour study room available daily; other study rooms can be reserved for 3-hour blocks.

cards.title: Wyatt Lecture Series
cards.subtitle: Free public intellectual talks
cards.notes: Attend free lectures featuring world-renowned writers, historians, and public leaders throughout the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A distinguished lecture series that brings high-profile speakers to campus for free public presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wyatt and Guarnaschelli Lecture Series are free public lectures that enrich the campus and Louisville community.
cards.access_notes: Lectures are free and open to the public; check the university calendar for specific dates and times.

cards.title: The Quad
cards.subtitle: Central campus green space
cards.notes: Relax on the lawn between classes or join student-led events like the Fall Involvement Fair in this central hub.
cards.short_summary: The primary outdoor gathering space on campus for social interaction, relaxation, and university events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fall Involvement Fair is held in the Quad to connect students with organizations and community.
cards.access_notes: Open public outdoor space; most active during daylight hours and between classes.

cards.title: Free Wellness Classes
cards.subtitle: Yoga, boxing, and pilates
cards.notes: Join free fitness sessions like yoga or pilates offered through the Wellness office to de-stress and stay active.
cards.short_summary: Regularly scheduled fitness and wellness classes provided at no cost to help students maintain a healthy lifestyle.
cards.evidence_claim: Many free classes are available through Wellness (yoga, boxing, and pilates are offered regularly).
cards.access_notes: Classes are typically held at the SuRF Center; check @bellarminewellness on Instagram for schedules.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: From 24-hour library rooms to quiet corners in the Siena complex, these are the most reliable spots for focused academic work on Bellarmine's campus.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Study Room
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, Level 1
cards.notes: Access this reliable space any time of day for late-night projects. It features computers, a coffee maker, and vending machines for long sessions.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock study environment in the library with essential amenities for extended academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has a 24-hour study room available to students daily, featuring computers, desks, and a coffee maker.
cards.source_title: Seven ways the Bellarmine Library supports student success
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students with valid ID.

cards.title: Level 2 Silent Study Space
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Head to the top floor for absolute quiet. Use the whiteboards to map out complex concepts or find a carrel for deep focus.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent zone on the library's second level equipped with whiteboards and individual carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: On Level 2, a large “silent study space” welcomes students to fill whiteboards with notes or type out an essay.
cards.source_title: Seven ways the Bellarmine Library supports student success
cards.access_notes: Available during standard library hours.

cards.title: Merton Center Reading Room
cards.subtitle: W.L. Lyons Brown Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Study surrounded by the world's largest Merton collection. This scholarly environment is perfect for quiet reading and research.
cards.short_summary: A specialized reading room housing the Thomas Merton archives, offering a quiet and academic atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: In the Center's reading room a complete set of books and journals by and about Merton is available; visitors are welcome to browse and read.
cards.source_title: The Thomas Merton Center at Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 9 am - 4 pm.

cards.title: Knights Knook
cards.subtitle: Centro, Horrigan Hall, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Relax in this renovated lounge featuring comfortable furniture and a fireplace. It is a great spot for casual studying between classes.
cards.short_summary: A cozy, renovated student lounge in Centro with a fireplace and comfortable seating for relaxed study.
cards.evidence_claim: Newly renovated, Knights Knook provides a great location for hanging with friends, relaxing and studying, featuring a fireplace and lounge furniture.
cards.access_notes: Located in Centro; accessible during building hours.

cards.title: The Math Center
cards.subtitle: Centro, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Utilize this quiet space filled with tables and whiteboards. Drop in for free tutoring or work independently on quantitative assignments.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated academic center providing a quiet environment and tutoring resources for math-related studies.
cards.evidence_claim: A quiet space with a multitude of tables, chairs, and whiteboards, this center is perfect for studying.
cards.source_title: 5 Bellarmine Resources Every Student Should Know About
cards.access_notes: Open for drop-in tutoring 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.

cards.title: Allen Hall Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Nolen C. Allen Hall, 3rd & 4th Floors
cards.notes: Find these rooms in the health sciences building for a more secluded atmosphere. They are often available for reservation during finals.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study rooms located in Nolen C. Allen Hall, ideal for students in the health science programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Allen Hall contains study rooms such as ALLN-313, 315, and 316, which can be reserved during final exams.
cards.access_notes: Located at 2120 Newburg Road; building hours apply.

cards.title: Siena Complex Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Siena Primo, Secondo, Terzo & Quarto
cards.notes: Take advantage of the 24-hour study areas within the Siena residence complex. These spots are convenient for residents living on the hill.
cards.short_summary: Resident-accessible study lounges located throughout the Siena housing complex, open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Study rooms are located in designated areas in the Siena Complex and are open 24 hours per day.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for residents of the Siena complex.

cards.title: Anniversary Hall Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Anniversary Hall, Floors 2-4
cards.notes: Use these floor-specific rooms for group work or solo sessions. They offer a quiet retreat within the traditional residence hall setting.
cards.short_summary: Designated study rooms on the upper floors of Anniversary Hall, providing 24-hour access for residents.
cards.evidence_claim: Study rooms are located on the second, third and fourth floors of Anniversary Hall and are open 24 hours per day.
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 for Anniversary Hall residents.

cards.title: The Crossover Lounge
cards.subtitle: Between Kennedy and Newman Halls
cards.notes: Study in this unique bridge space connecting two residence halls. It serves as a communal lounge and recreational area for residents.
cards.short_summary: A connecting lounge between Kennedy and Newman Halls that provides space for both recreation and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Kennedy Hall connects with Newman Hall via The Crossover, a lounge and recreational space residents of both buildings can use.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residents of Kennedy and Newman Halls.

cards.title: SuRF Center Lobby
cards.subtitle: Sport, Recreation and Fitness Center
cards.notes: Grab a seat in the lobby for a casual study session before or after your workout. It is a high-energy spot for active students.
cards.short_summary: The entrance lobby of the SuRF Center, offering a space for students to gather and study in a fitness-oriented environment.
cards.evidence_claim: The SuRF Center Lobby (SURF-LOB) is listed as a usable room/space on the university events calendar.
cards.source_title: Rooms view - Bellarmine University Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Open during SuRF Center hours (typically until 11 PM on weekdays).

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the streets and corridors surrounding Bellarmine University, from the eclectic Highlands to the quiet parks and student-frequented coffee shops just steps from the gates.

cards.title: Sunergos Coffee
cards.subtitle: Norris Place
cards.notes: Walk two blocks from campus to this local favorite for a cold brew or latte. It is a common spot for students to study or hold professional meetings in a welcoming environment.
cards.short_summary: A popular student coffee shop located just two blocks from the Bellarmine campus on Norris Place.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunergos Coffee is located only two blocks from campus on Norris Place and is a very common place for Bellarmine students to visit for coffee and studying.
cards.source_title: Sunergos: A Big Hit at Bellarmine - Knights Media Network
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6:30 AM to 7:00 PM.

cards.title: Joe Creason Park
cards.subtitle: Newburg Road
cards.notes: Cross Newburg Road to access 68 acres of green space. Use the paved multi-use path that connects the university property directly to the park's tennis center and trails.
cards.short_summary: A 68-acre public park located directly across Newburg Road from Bellarmine University, featuring a connecting multi-use path.
cards.evidence_claim: Joe Creason Park is right across the street from Bellarmine and includes a paved multi-use path system that connects the university property with the park.
cards.source_title: Bellarmine University connected with Joe Creason Park in new multi-use recreational path project
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; the connecting path is accessible during daylight hours.

cards.title: Baxter Avenue Theatres
cards.subtitle: Bardstown Road Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this cinema in Mid-City Mall for independent and foreign films. Show your Bellarmine ID to receive a discounted student ticket for a movie night with friends.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing cinema in the Highlands offering student discounts and a mix of mainstream and independent films.
cards.evidence_claim: Baxter Avenue Theatres offers discounted student tickets for $8.50 and is a popular destination for Bellarmine students in the Highlands.
cards.source_title: Five must-visit places in the Highlands - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Located inside Mid-City Mall; check website for daily showtimes.

cards.title: The Great Escape
cards.subtitle: Bardstown Road
cards.notes: Browse a massive selection of comic books, vinyl records, and collectibles. This Highlands staple is a frequent stop for students looking for unique media and pop culture items.
cards.short_summary: An iconic Highlands shop specializing in comics, music, and collectibles, popular with the local student community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Escape is a staple of the Highlands known for its variety of music, comics, and collectibles, making it a fun pit stop for students.
cards.source_title: Five must-visit places in the Highlands - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check store for specific hours.

cards.title: Vintage Banana
cards.subtitle: Bardstown Road
cards.notes: Find this 'hole in the wall' shop at the end of an alleyway for retro clothing. It is a go-to for students seeking sustainable fashion and one-of-a-kind vintage pieces.
cards.short_summary: A hidden vintage clothing store in the Highlands known for its retro styles and sustainable shopping options.
cards.evidence_claim: Vintage Banana is a retro clothing store found at the end of an alleyway in the Highlands, frequently visited by Bellarmine students for sustainable fashion.
cards.source_title: Five must-visit places in the Highlands - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Look for the kitschy banana sign on the street to find the alley entrance.

cards.title: Cherokee Park
cards.subtitle: Eastern Parkway
cards.notes: Head a few blocks northeast to explore this 400-acre park. Walk or bike the 2.3-mile Scenic Loop for a quick escape into nature designed by Frederick Law Olmsted.
cards.short_summary: A major 400-acre public park near campus featuring a famous scenic loop and extensive recreational trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Cherokee Park is a 400-acre park designed by Frederick Law Olmsted located a few blocks northeast of Bardstown Road, near the Bellarmine campus.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Douglass Loop
cards.subtitle: Bardstown Road
cards.notes: Visit this historic trolley turnaround area for the seasonal farmers market. It serves as a community hub with local eateries and shops within walking distance of student housing.
cards.short_summary: A historic commercial node on Bardstown Road featuring a popular farmers market and local businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: Douglass Loop is a featured Highlands experience for Bellarmine students, specifically noted for its Farmers Market.
cards.access_notes: The Farmers Market typically runs on Saturdays during the warmer months.

cards.title: Einstein Bros. Bagels
cards.subtitle: Newburg Road
cards.notes: Grab a quick breakfast sandwich or coffee at this convenient spot right on the edge of campus. It is a reliable morning stop for commuters and residential students alike.
cards.short_summary: A popular breakfast and coffee chain located on Newburg Road at the entrance to Bellarmine University.
cards.evidence_claim: Einstein Bros. Bagels is located at 2001 Newburg Rd, directly serving the Bellarmine University community.
cards.source_title: Discover Einstein Bros. Bagels In Louisville, KY
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 7:30 AM - 8:00 PM, Friday until 5:00 PM. Closed weekends.

cards.title: Ramen House
cards.subtitle: Baxter Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Enjoy authentic ramen and bao buns at this highly-rated restaurant. Now located on South Spring Street, it remains a top recommendation for students exploring the Highlands area.
cards.short_summary: A popular Japanese restaurant known for its quality ramen, formerly in Mid-City Mall and now nearby in Irish Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramen House is a standout place worth a visit for Bellarmine students, specializing in ramen, buns, and dumplings.
cards.source_title: Five must-visit places in the Highlands - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Recently moved from Mid-City Mall to 204 S. Spring St. Check social media for current hours.

cards.title: Beargrass Creek Path
cards.subtitle: Poplar Level Road Connection
cards.notes: Use the bridge behind Allen Hall to reach neighborhoods along Poplar Level Road. This path cuts a long walk down to 15 minutes, connecting campus to the broader Highlands area.
cards.short_summary: A pedestrian bridge and path connecting Bellarmine's campus to surrounding neighborhoods over Beargrass Creek.
cards.evidence_claim: A new walking path and bridge connects Bellarmine's campus with neighborhoods along Poplar Level Road, providing safe passage over Beargrass Creek.
cards.source_title: New walking path and bridge on campus create access over Beargrass Creek
cards.access_notes: Open to pedestrians and bicyclists during daylight hours.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: From the legendary details of the Knight statue to the annual fireworks of Sparks at Knight, these traditions define the Bellarmine experience in Louisville.

cards.title: Decoding the Knight's Details
cards.subtitle: A 13-foot bronze sculpture by Bob Lockhart
cards.notes: Examine the statue to find ten lizards representing life's irritations and a fortune cookie hidden among the bells on the horse's leg.
cards.short_summary: A massive bronze mascot statue filled with symbolic and humorous hidden details by artist Bob Lockhart.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bellarmine Knight sculpture features ten lizards representing irritations and a fortune cookie among the bells on the horse's leg.
cards.source_title: A Knight's Tale/Tail Two - Knights of Creativity Spirit & Ale
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors on the main campus walkway near the library; accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Sparks at Knight Fireworks
cards.subtitle: The annual welcome-back carnival
cards.notes: Attend this carnival on the first Saturday of the fall semester, featuring games and a massive fireworks display at 9:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: An annual fall semester kickoff carnival for students and staff that concludes with a signature fireworks show.
cards.evidence_claim: Sparks at Knight is a welcome back carnival taking place annually on the first Saturday of the fall semester, culminating in fireworks at 9:30 pm.
cards.access_notes: Held on the campus grounds during the first week of the fall semester.

cards.title: Late Knight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Fueling up before Study Day
cards.notes: Head to the University Dining Hall the night before Study Day to be served a free breakfast by university faculty and staff.
cards.short_summary: A semesterly tradition where faculty and staff serve students breakfast to support them before final exams.
cards.evidence_claim: Faculty and staff serve a free breakfast to students in the University Dining Hall each semester on the night before Study Day.
cards.access_notes: Takes place in the University Dining Hall during finals week; check campus calendar for exact late-night hours.

cards.title: Ball on the Belle
cards.subtitle: A Halloween cruise on the Ohio River
cards.notes: Board the Belle of Louisville for this annual Halloween dance party and river cruise organized by the Bellarmine Activities Council.
cards.short_summary: An annual Halloween-themed dance party held aboard the historic Belle of Louisville steamboat.
cards.evidence_claim: Ball on the Belle is an annual Halloween Dance Party where the university rents out the Belle of Louisville for a cruise down the Ohio River.
cards.access_notes: Requires boarding at the Louisville waterfront; transportation is typically provided from campus.

cards.title: The Hillside Concert
cards.subtitle: Spring music in the natural amphitheater
cards.notes: Join the crowd for this annual spring concert, named for its original location on the hill behind the Brown Activities Center.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing spring concert series featuring contemporary musical artists performed for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hillside Concert is a spring tradition at Bellarmine, named because the original concert was held in the natural amphitheatre on the hillside.
cards.source_title: Bellarmine concert by Sara Bareilles a sellout
cards.access_notes: Location varies between the campus hillside and Knights Hall; check current year event details.

cards.title: Knights in Action Day
cards.subtitle: First-year service tradition
cards.notes: Join your entire first-year class to volunteer at nonprofit sites across Louisville during the final days of the Week of Welcome.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale community service event where the entire incoming freshman class participates in local volunteer projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Knights in Action is a program where the entire first-year class goes to nonprofit community partner sites to complete projects at the end of Week of Welcome.
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for first-year students as part of the BU100 course curriculum.

cards.title: The President's Toast
cards.subtitle: A Senior Week celebration
cards.notes: Gather in the Centro Atrium during Senior Week for a formal toast with the University President to celebrate your upcoming graduation.
cards.short_summary: A celebratory event for graduating seniors featuring a toast by the University President during the week of commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: The President's Toast is a Senior Week event for graduating seniors held in the Centro Atrium.
cards.source_title: Senior Week and Graduate Events - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Open to graduating seniors; typically held in the afternoon during Senior Week.

cards.title: The Golden Egg Quest
cards.subtitle: Spring campus-wide scavenger hunt
cards.notes: Search the campus grounds during the spring semester to find hidden eggs, including the rare golden eggs that carry high-value prizes.
cards.short_summary: A competitive spring egg hunt where students search for prizes ranging from small treats to electronics.
cards.evidence_claim: Egg Quest is a spring semester hunt where students find eggs around campus to claim prizes, including golden eggs with high-value items.
cards.access_notes: Open to all current students; held outdoors across the main campus.

cards.title: Photos at the Arch
cards.subtitle: A graduation rite of passage
cards.notes: Visit the stone arch on Newburg Road during Senior Week to take your official commemorative graduation photos with classmates.
cards.short_summary: A traditional photo opportunity for graduating seniors at the university's iconic stone entrance arch.
cards.evidence_claim: Photos at the Arch is a Senior Week tradition held at the Bellarmine Arch on Newburg Road.
cards.source_title: Senior Week and Graduate Events - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Located at the campus entrance on Newburg Road; accessible 24/7 for photos.

cards.title: Late Knight Bingo
cards.subtitle: High-stakes Homecoming fun
cards.notes: Join this high-energy Homecoming Week event to compete for prizes in a packed room of fellow Knights.
cards.short_summary: A popular Homecoming Week event where students play bingo for various prizes in a social setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Knight Bingo is a signature event held during the annual Homecoming Week.
cards.access_notes: Typically held in Frazier Hall or the University Dining Hall; check the Homecoming schedule for times.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Bellarmine University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A guide to the essential first-weekend experiences for new students at Bellarmine University, from move-in traditions to late-night social events.

cards.title: Check-In Central
cards.subtitle: The Official Start of Move-In
cards.notes: Arrive at Frazier Hall to collect your room keys and student ID. This central hub also hosts a resource fair with financial aid and advising staff.
cards.short_summary: The primary check-in location for new residential and commuter students during move-in weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Frazier Hall serves as the location for Check-In Central for first-year students during the Week of Welcome.
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for first-year students; typically open from 8:30 AM to 2:30 PM on move-in Saturday.

cards.title: Family Lunch & Matriculation
cards.subtitle: Signing the Matriculation Book
cards.notes: Join the President for lunch and sign the official matriculation book, a tradition marking your formal entry into the Bellarmine community.
cards.short_summary: A formal welcome event where students sign the university's matriculation book.
cards.evidence_claim: The Family Lunch with the President includes the welcome and signing of the matriculation book at the University Dining Hall.
cards.access_notes: Held on Saturday of move-in weekend; families are welcome to attend.

cards.title: New Knight Social
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Games and Music
cards.notes: Head to historic Knights Hall for an evening of games, music, and food designed to help you meet your new classmates in a relaxed setting.
cards.short_summary: A Saturday evening social event for new students held in the university's primary athletic arena.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Student Social is held at Knights Hall on the Saturday of move-in weekend.
cards.access_notes: Typically starts at 6:30 PM on Saturday evening.

cards.title: Sparks at Knight
cards.subtitle: Fireworks and Carnival
cards.notes: Celebrate the start of the year with a carnival on the Quad featuring food trucks and games, culminating in a major fireworks display at 9:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: An annual welcome-back carnival and fireworks show held on the first Saturday of the fall semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Sparks at Knight is a welcome back carnival that takes place on the first Saturday of the fall semester and ends with fireworks.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; fireworks are visible from the hill behind the Dining Hall.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady of the Woods Chapel
cards.title: Sunday Worship
cards.subtitle: Reflection in the Woods
cards.notes: Attend Sunday Mass or find a quiet moment for reflection at this scenic chapel located in a wooded area of campus.
cards.short_summary: The university's principal Roman Catholic chapel, offering Sunday services and a space for quiet meditation.
cards.evidence_claim: The community celebrates Mass in the Our Lady of the Woods Chapel on Sundays.
cards.source_title: About Our Lady of the Woods Chapel - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Open for prayer daily; Mass times are typically posted on the Campus Ministry site.

cards.title: SuRF Center Visit
cards.subtitle: Fitness and Recreation
cards.notes: Activate your membership at the Sport, Recreation, and Fitness Center. Use your student ID for free access to the gym, courts, and fitness classes.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub for fitness, featuring a weight room, basketball courts, and intramural sports.
cards.evidence_claim: Membership to the SuRF Center is free for all current Bellarmine students with a valid ID.
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday 12:00 PM - 7:00 PM during the fall semester.

cards.title: Late Night Dinner
cards.subtitle: Socializing Over Food
cards.notes: Join fellow students for a late-night meal at the UDH. It's a prime time for residential students to gather after evening orientation activities.
cards.short_summary: The main dining hall offers extended hours for social dining during the Week of Welcome.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Night Dinner is scheduled at the University Dining Hall from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM during move-in weekend.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM on Saturday of move-in weekend.

cards.title: Knights in Action
cards.subtitle: Community Service Day
cards.notes: Join your BU100 class for a morning of service at various nonprofit sites across Louisville, a signature tradition for all first-year students.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale service project where the entire first-year class volunteers at local nonprofits.
cards.evidence_claim: Knights in Action is a service project for the entire first-year class held at the end of the Week of Welcome.
cards.source_title: Signature Community Engagement Experiences - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for first-year students; transportation is typically provided from campus.

cards.title: Knights Soccer Game
cards.subtitle: Cheer on the Home Team
cards.notes: Experience the school spirit at Frazier Stadium. Catch a home soccer game and participate in the halftime contests and giveaways.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary outdoor athletic venue, hosting soccer and lacrosse matches.
cards.evidence_claim: Men's and Women's soccer games are held at Owsley B. Frazier Stadium, often featuring student events during the first week.
cards.access_notes: Check the athletics calendar for specific game times; student admission is typically free with ID.

cards.title: Library Exploration
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Study Space
cards.notes: Locate the 24-hour study room and collaborative spaces in the library. It's a great spot to organize your first week's syllabus and notes.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library, offering extensive resources and a dedicated 24-hour study area for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The W.L. Lyons Brown Library features a 24-hour study room available to students daily.
cards.source_title: W. L. Lyons Brown Library - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Main library hours vary; the 24-hour study room is accessible via student ID.
